answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Spinner guild membership works as the check: a membership the guild renews after spun yarns. A farm faking 362 aliases needs 362 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the ember signal is public, the pulse check is automatic, and 362 aliases cost 362 times what one real agent costs, with the summit trail open to all.
